finding.statement: After an ambiguous timeout, retrying create with a new idempotency key created a second resource in this synthetic API v2 run.

applicability.description: A create call timed out ambiguously and the retry changed the key.
conditions: The retry used a new idempotency key.
exclusions: The retry used the original idempotency key.

evidence.excerpt: synthetic run failure-1: timeout; retry with new key K2; second resource id returned
